# NeuroCode AI
> On-Device Autonomous Software Engineering: In-Memory Code Property Graph Reachability Slicing under Edge VRAM Constraints.

## Overview
NeuroCode offloads codebase structural analysis to Host CPU/DRAM using Tree-sitter and in-memory Code Property Multigraphs (CPG). It extracts bidirectional reachability closures in 0.62 ms, strictly bounding context to < 1,500 tokens (97.1% token cut) for on-device LLMs (1.5B–14B parameters) running under edge VRAM constraints (< 8 GB VRAM).

## Tools & API Endpoints for AI Agents
- **POST /api/slice**: Returns bounded AST knapsack slice for an issue/bug report.
  - Payload: `{"code": "<source code>", "query": "<issue description or symbol>", "budget": 1500}`
  - Response: `{"tokens_original": 44687, "tokens_sliced": 1314, "reduction_pct": 97.1, "sliced_context": "..."}`
- **POST /api/mcp**: Remote JSON-RPC 2.0 Model Context Protocol endpoint.
  - Tools supported: `neurocode_slice`, `neurocode_trace`, `neurocode_map`, `neurocode_graft`.
- **SSE /api/mcp/sse**: Streaming Model Context Protocol endpoint for Cursor and Claude Desktop.

## Software Artifacts & Downloads

- **VS Code Extension (Windows 1-Click .exe)**: `https://neurocode.deepak-arkz.me/downloads/NeuroCode-Setup.exe`

- **Install Script**: `curl -fsSL https://neurocode.deepak-arkz.me/downloads/install.sh | bash`
